page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.32xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The instance features 128 dedicated virtual CPUs and 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps to support high-throughput data transfers. There are no integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

The high memory density of the ecs.r7a.32xlarge makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive RAM allocations without the overhead of dedicated physical hardware. It is designed for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale in-memory databases, big data analytics, and caching layers.
